nom: The Crème Shop Gelly Brightening Under Eye Patches

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe themselves as sensitive report mixed results: some note burning, redness, or slight irritation (especially if left on too long or sensitive to scent), while others with sensitive skin found the thin patches gentle and non-irritating.
segments.dry: A reviewer with thin, dry under-eye skin found the patches moisturizing and slightly tightening but not fully able to erase dark circles caused by thinness of skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother, softer under-eye skin and reduced appearance of fine lines after use, with one noting fine lines looked less pronounced after 15–20 minutes.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the patches as strongly hydrating, leaving skin plumped, softer, and less dry-looking; one reviewer felt the top of the patch was drier than the rest and wished for more product.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reported irritation and redness after use, while another explicitly noted no irritation or redness at all; results appear inconsistent for reactive skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer described her skin burning and reacting oddly, and another sensitive-skin user noted burning if patches were left on more than five minutes, though most other users reported no burning or compromise.
concerns.spots: No reviewer specifically discusses spots or blemish-prone skin in relation to this product.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer specifically discusses acne or active blemishes with this product.
concerns.oiliness: No reviewer discusses oily skin or oil control with this product.

aspects.libelle: Patches slip or slide down the face
Glitter stars flake off and stick to skin
Good value for quantity in jar

extraits.texte: Very refreshing and brightening feeling. However, if you have sensitive skin, I wouldn't recommend. Had some slight irritation and redness from it, nothing major but certainly not for those that could easily flair up from unfamiliar products.

I think these do really plump up the under eye area and it feels nicely moisturized afterwards. I also let my brother try them and he loves them. I do have sensitive skin and if I leave them on for any longer than 5 minutes my skin burns a bit so I only leave them on for 5 minutes and I still notice an improvement. I feel like a lot of face mask and eye masks do the same since my skin is sensitive overall. I would recommend this to my friends and family. I did receive this product for free in exchange for an honest review.
Looks I'm the odd ball out but these actually burn my skin and smell weird

These pink starry undereye patches are cute and refreshing! I'd leave them on after washing my face in the morning while I did other parts of my morning routine. I have dark undereyes due to thin skin, so it didn't completely relieve that. It did leave my skin moisturized and a little tighter feeling but not in a negative way. Applying makeup afterwards also went on nicer than usual.

I recently tried the Gelly Under Eye Patches (Crème) and was genuinely impressed with how refreshing they felt. The texture is soft and cushiony, and they adhere really well without sliding around, which makes them perfect for wearing while getting ready in the morning. As soon as I applied them, I noticed a cooling, soothing sensation that instantly helped de-puff my under-eye area. After about 15–20 minutes, my under-eyes looked noticeably more hydrated and smoother. Fine lines appeared less pronounced, and my concealer applied much more seamlessly afterward. What I especially liked about the crème version is that it feels nourishing without being heavy or sticky. Once I removed the patches, the remaining serum absorbed quickly into my skin and didn't pill under makeup. Overall, these are a great quick fix for tired eyes—whether after a late night, a long flight, or when your under-eye area needs an extra boost of hydration. I'll definitely be keeping these in my routine for self-care days and special events.
I lovee using these! No irritation or redness at all. These are sooo cute and I will be recommending them to everyone

I've been using the product mostly at night right after my skin care routine, and I've noticed a big difference with how puffy my eye bags are. The swelling has gone down a lot and they are not as dark anymore. I would definitely recommend these to anyone with super puffy eye bags!
